status.current_name: Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd.
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells a wide range of commercial soft serve ice cream machines under its own brand, PASMO.
status.evidence: Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd. actively advertises and distributes its range of commercial soft serve ice cream machines globally through its official portal and authorized dealer networks as of 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports that its S230F model achieves ultra-fast freezing in under 5 minutes utilizing a pre-cooling hopper with a built-in agitator, according to the PASMO Soft Serve Video Presentation.
claims.source: Operational Video of Pasmo Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine (YouTube)

claims.claim: The company reports that its specialized gear-type air pump system allows operators to combine ice cream mix and air to achieve custom overruns ranging from 0% to 60% volume, as documented in the PASMO America Air Pump Analysis.
claims.source: The reason for an Air Pump - Pasmo America Website

claims.claim: The company reports that commercial models like the S970F employ an integrated seamless cylinder configuration paired with a 304 stainless steel beater and clip scrapers to maximize texture consistency, as outlined in the PASMO America S970F Specifications.
claims.source: S970F Floor Standing Soft Serve Freezer Specs - Pasmo America Website

claims.claim: The company reports that its gravity-fed machine configurations inject air down into the freezing cylinder via a specialized feed tube to maintain a fixed 30% overrun ratio, according to the PASMO America Gravity vs Pump Guide.
claims.source: Gravity or Pump soft serve machine? - Pasmo America Website

claims.claim: The company’s technical operation manuals outline that operators can manually adjust the overrun output by moving the adjustment duct or setting the air pump's adjustable gear position.

The company reports a comprehensive line of countertop soft-serve machine models, including the S110F (20 liters/hour, 1 flavor), S230F (30 liters/hour, 2 flavors plus 1 twist), and S930F (40 liters/hour, 1 flavor) variant.
claims.source: PASMO America Spec Sheets (S110F: 20 L/H, 1 flavor; S230F: 30 L/H, 2 flavors + 1 twist; S930F: 40 L/H, 1 flavor)

claims.claim: The company reports floor-standing commercial soft-serve models, featuring the standalone S520F (50 liters/hour, 2+1 twist flavors) and the S970F/S970F-T series (up to 60 liters/hour, 2+1 twist configurations).
claims.source: PASMO America & PASMO China Product Catalogs (S520F: 50 L/H, 2+1 twist; S970F: 60 L/H / S970F-T: 55 L/H, 2+1 twist configurations)

claims.claim: The company reports that its machinery is available in both gravity-fed (such as S110F and S230F) and pressurized air pump-fed variants (such as S930T Pressurized, S111, and S970FT).
claims.source: PASMO America & PASMO China Machine Matrix / Spec Documentation

claims.claim: The company reports specialized commercial variants with built-in pasteurization technology, such as the single-flavor S930TP model designed to heat and sanitize product mixes overnight.
claims.source: PASMO China Single Cylinder Product Guide (S930TP includes Pasteurization Function / 14 Days No Cleaning)

claims.claim: The company reports that its S970FAP2 floor-model pressurized soft-serve machine delivers an hourly throughput capacity of up to 55 liters per hour.
claims.source: PASMO USA S970FAP2 Equipment Specification Listing (55 ltr per hour production capacity)

claims.claim: The company reports that its S930TP soft-serve machine has an initial batch readiness recovery time of 6 to 8 minutes and is capable of a continuous discharge of 25 cups or more.
claims.source: PASMO Product Specifications & DS Refrigeration Product Page

claims.claim: The company reports that its S111 table-top soft-serve freezer features an hourly production capacity of up to 50 liters per hour.
claims.source: PASMO America & PASMO China S111 Spec Sheets

claims.claim: The company reports that its S230F gravity-fed machine provides a continuous discharging ability of 15 cups or more per single cylinder and an initial freezing recovery time of 8 to 10 minutes.
claims.source: PASMO China S230F Gravity Product Data

claims.claim: The company reports that the Pasmo S230FA2 soft serve machine delivers a throughput of 253 servings per hour, according to specifications from Plant Based Pros.
claims.corrected: The company reports that the Pasmo S230FA2 soft serve machine delivers a throughput of 30 liters per hour, according to specifications from Plant Based Pros.
claims.source: Plant Based Pros & FedCanada PASMO S230FA2 Specification Sheets

claims.claim: The Pasmo S110F table top soft ice cream machine features a documented power consumption of 1.5 kW and incorporates frequency conversion and soft-starting technology to optimize efficiency, according to DS Refrigeration.
claims.source: DS Refrigeration & PASMO America S110F Product Specifications

claims.claim: The Pasmo S930FT Air Pump soft serve ice cream machine is configured with eco-friendly R290 refrigerant to enhance environmental sustainability while delivering a production capacity of 45 kg per hour, according to CT Concepts Food Equipment.
claims.corrected: The Pasmo S930FT Air Pump soft serve ice cream machine is configured with R404A refrigerant while delivering a production capacity of 45 kg per hour, according to CT Concepts Food Equipment.
claims.source: PASMO Official Product Specifications & CT Concepts

claims.claim: The Pasmo S970F floor standing soft serve freezer features a standard power consumption rating of 3.2 kW and integrates an energy-saving 4.4°C evening standby function, according to Pasmo America.

The Pasmo S728A1 countertop multi-functional unit uses a self-contained refrigeration system utilizing eco-friendly R290 refrigerant with a power consumption of 750 watts, according to KitchenRestock.
claims.corrected: The Pasmo S728A1 countertop multi-functional unit uses a self-contained refrigeration system utilizing eco-friendly R290 refrigerant with a power consumption of 750 watts, according to KitchenRestock.

claims.claim: The standard Pasmo S111 table top soft serve freezer utilizes R-404A refrigerant gas with a specified total power consumption of 2.2 kW, according to Pasmo America.

The company's PASMO S930FT model integrates an LED touch screen with a screen lock feature, an intelligent microprocessor control system, and daily sales counting as standard equipment, according to official product specifications from Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd.
claims.source: Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd. Official Product Specifications

claims.claim: The company's PASMO S121 soft-serve machine model incorporates a specialized Touch Screen Control panel interface to manage operational parameters, as announced in an official product release video in July 2026.
claims.note: Touch Screen Control panel interface, product release video in July 2026

claims.claim: Orange Leaf, a frozen yogurt franchise brand under BRIX Holdings, announced in July 2024 that it selected PASMO to equip new store locations with its soft-serve machines.
claims.note: Orange Leaf selecting PASMO in July 2024

claims.claim: Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd. reports official client supply relationships and agreements with major international quick-service brands, including McDonald's Malaysia and Burger King.
PASMO soft-serve machines are actively utilized by commercial food and beverage brands such as Paik's Coffee, as well as on US military bases in Japan and South Korea via PASMO USA.
claims.corrected: PASMO soft-serve machines are actively utilized by commercial food and beverage brands such as Paik's Coffee, as well as on US military bases in Japan and South Korea via PASMO America.

claims.claim: The company reports that its partnerships and clients for soft-serve equipment include McDonald's Malaysia, Burger King, Lawson Thailand, 7-Eleven Malaysia, and US military bases in Japan/Korea via PASMO USA, according to the official PASMO website.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its partnerships and clients for soft-serve equipment include McDonald's Malaysia, Burger King, Lawson Thailand, 7-Eleven Malaysia, and US military bases in Japan/Korea via PASMO America, according to the official PASMO website.

claims.claim: The company reports that commercial chains with over 400 locations have chosen PASMO soft-serve machines, according to a PASMO America press release.
claims.source: PASMO America press release via International Frozen Yogurt Association (https://internationalfrozenyogurt.com)

claims.claim: The company reports that it maintains international operations across more than 25 regions, including Taiwan, Thailand, the USA, the UK, France, Germany, South Africa, and Saudi Arabia.

The company reports that it provides 24/7 global customer support via its service hotline (400-7576-999), remote troubleshooting, and maintenance guidance through its certified global distribution network.

The company was established in 2013 as a joint venture involving Tafa (Thailand) and Pasmo Australia, followed by the founding of Taiwan Pasmo in 2014 and a expansion of over a dozen international branches starting in 2015.
claims.source: PASMO Product Catalog / Corporate History Document (https://universalsteel.com.sg/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Pasmo_Soft-Serve-Machines.pdf)

claims.claim: The company's regional operations under Pasmo America feature a dedicated facility in Denver, Colorado, housing the PASMO Innovation Center, Test Kitchen, USA ServiceLine, and a Parts Distribution Warehouse.
The company reports that its manufacturing facility in Taizhou City covers 40,000 square meters, according to the Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd. profile.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its manufacturing facility in Taizhou City covers 10,471 square meters, according to the Taizhou Pasmo Food Technology Co., Ltd. profile.

The company reports that it has ongoing investment in advanced manufacturing equipment and processes housed in a 335,000-square-foot facility alongside a 200,000-square-foot factory for ice cream and slush machines.
